remediation.suggestion: Document exclude patterns for secrets, generated files, vendor directories, and private configuration paths.

content.value_statement: Teams often lose time when docs drift away from code. This skill creates structured documentation plans, drafts, examples, and automation guidance from source material.
actual_capabilities: Creates documentation plans for APIs, architecture, user guides, and technical references.
Drafts OpenAPI and Swagger documentation structures from endpoint information.
Outlines architecture diagrams using Mermaid or PlantUML patterns.
Builds README, setup, troubleshooting, and contribution guide templates.
Suggests CI workflows, linting, coverage checks, and documentation deployment steps.
limitations: Requires accurate code, configuration, or requirements as source material.
Generated documentation needs human review before publication.
Examples may need adaptation for each project framework and toolchain.
Does not verify live API behavior without separate testing tools.

use_cases.title: Document a New API Service
use_cases.description: Turn endpoint definitions and models into API references, examples, and authentication notes.

use_cases.title: Standardize Project Documentation
use_cases.description: Create consistent README, setup, configuration, and contribution sections across repositories.

use_cases.title: Build Documentation Automation
use_cases.description: Plan CI checks, coverage reports, and publishing steps for living documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Documentation Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a repository documentation outline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a documentation plan for this repository. Identify audiences, source files, required docs, missing context, and review steps.

prompt_templates.title: Draft API Documentation
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for API reference material.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft API documentation from these routes and models. Include endpoints, parameters, responses, authentication, errors, and example workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Architecture Docs
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for system design documentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create architecture documentation for these services. Include component responsibilities, data flows, dependencies, operational concerns, and diagram guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Design Documentation Automation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for continuous documentation maintenance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a documentation automation workflow. Include generation steps, linting, coverage checks, CI gates, publishing, and owner review responsibilities.

output_examples.input: A FastAPI service with route files, Pydantic models, and authentication middleware.
output: API reference outline with endpoint groups, request fields, response summaries, and error cases.
Authentication section explaining token usage, permissions, and safe placeholder handling.
Review checklist for missing descriptions, undocumented responses, and outdated examples.

output_examples.input: A microservice repository with deployment notes and service dependencies.
output: Architecture guide covering service purpose, dependencies, data flow, and operational boundaries.
Diagram plan for frontend, gateway, services, databases, and external integrations.
Runbook sections for setup, configuration, troubleshooting, and release notes.

output_examples.input: A project with inconsistent README files and no documentation checks.
output: Standard README structure for setup, usage, configuration, testing, and contribution guidance.
Documentation automation plan with linting, coverage checks, CI review, and publishing steps.

best_practices: Provide current source files, configuration examples, and audience goals before generation.
Review generated docs for accuracy, missing context, secrets, and internal-only details.
Keep documentation checks in CI so stale pages are caught before release.
anti_patterns: Publishing generated docs without reviewing code accuracy and sensitive data exposure.
Using one generic README structure for every service without audience-specific sections.
Documenting examples that cannot be tested or maintained by the owning team.

faq.question: What documentation can this skill generate?
faq.answer: It can help create API docs, architecture guides, README content, user guides, and automation plans.

faq.question: Does it execute code from my repository?
faq.answer: No. It guides documentation generation from supplied code and context. Separate tools are needed to run tests or APIs.

faq.question: Can it create OpenAPI documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft OpenAPI structures from endpoint, model, authentication, and response information.

faq.question: How should I handle secrets in generated docs?
faq.answer: Use placeholders, redact private values, and review configs before publishing any generated documentation.

faq.question: Can it help maintain documentation over time?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest CI checks, linting, coverage validation, and publishing workflows.

faq.question: Who should review the output?
faq.answer: The code owner, API owner, or technical writer should verify accuracy before docs are published.
